title: This Animal Regrows Its Own Brain 🦎 #shorts
description: The axolotl can regrow limbs, its spinal cord and even parts of its brain, and it keeps its baby features for life.

scenes.text: This animal can regrow its legs, its spinal cord, and even parts of its brain.
It's the axolotl, a salamander that never really grows up. It keeps its baby features, like these feathery gills, for its whole life.
If it loses a leg, a new one grows back in a matter of weeks. Bones, muscles, nerves. And no scar.
Scientists study it to understand how humans might one day heal the same way.
But in the wild, it's almost gone. It survives only in a few canals around Mexico City.
Follow for more creatures that break the rules.
